details.summary: What is HYDRO-BLOK, and what does the customer see?
details.p: HYDRO-BLOK provides the shower base, coated tile-ready panels and waterproofing system beneath the finished tile. Customers see the tile, glass, drain trim, niches and benches selected for their design. Properly detailed seams, corners and connections are essential to the assembly.

details.summary: Does a dealer have to stock every shower pan and drain?
details.p: No. Start with one project, or discuss a practical assortment of wallboard, sealant, screws and washers. Dalla Terra's existing dealer portal accepts requests for project-specific product availability, freight quotations and orders. Availability and freight are confirmed before acceptance.

details.summary: Can I plan a curbless shower, bench, niche or concealed drain?
details.p: These can be considered when the building structure and specified system permit them. Plan elevations, suitable pans, drain positions, waterproofing transitions, glass and tile together. Different drain appearances require their matching components; use the Shower Planner to explore options, then confirm compatibility.

The pan and coated panels are only part of the assembly. Use the specified joint sealant and fastening details, with the required treatment of every seam, corner, drain connection and penetration. Follow current manufacturer instructions and complete any applicable tests before tiling.

details.summary: How can a concealed drain be cleaned?
details.p: Appropriate drain and trim combinations retain their intended cleaning and service access. Confirm the exact selected product's access method before finalizing drain position, tile and glass layout.

details.summary: Can HYDRO-BLOK work with heated floors or steam showers?
details.p: Some heating designs are possible with a compatible assembly, but electrical heating, waterproofing and tile layers must all be approved for the intended application. Steam showers have additional vapour-control requirements. Do not assume a standard shower assembly automatically qualifies.

details.summary: How does a dealer plan components and submit a request?
details.p: Use the Shower Planner to explore dimensions and estimate materials. Sign in to the existing Dalla Terra dealer portal to prepare a stock check, quote, freight or order request. Final quantities, unit or carton details and availability must be confirmed.

details.summary: What does HYDRO-BLOK's limited lifetime warranty cover?
details.p: It is a limited lifetime product warranty subject to specified defects, installation conditions, registration and other exclusions—not a guarantee against every leak or workmanship issue. Read the manufacturer's current written terms ↗.

article.span: Coated closed-cell XPS + specified joint sealant
article.p: Pre-sloped pans, reinforced cement-coated tile-ready wallboards and matched components. The specified joint sealant connects the waterproof assembly, with additional manufacturer's reinforcement details at some transitions.

article.span: Bonded sheet membrane and compatible components
article.p: KERDI sheets bond to a suitable substrate with specified overlapped seams. Schluter also offers prefabricated pans and waterproof KERDI-BOARD. It is not accurate to describe every Schluter installation as membrane over drywall.

article.span: Coated XPS panels with specified joint sealant
article.p: Prefabricated shower bases and cement-coated waterproof building panels use a comparable broad construction approach, with their own approved connections, drainage and installation details.

article.span: Boards, liquid membranes and prepared shower pans
article.p: The system family includes waterproof board, liquid-applied membrane and modular pan options. The complete waterproofing assembly depends on the selected products.
